moderate: what/line 4 (closing invitation, emotional state 'inviting openness'): the reader (same identity as the opening traveller) shows a downturned, anxious mouth with raised inner brows from the 15% frame through the final frame in all three themes; the authored 'curious' expression renders as worried, and the 'invite' gesture is barely perceptible, so the film ends on an apprehensive face instead of an invitation (qa/screenshots/*-02-sentence-4.png, *-02-last.png).
minor: why/line 3: the witness's open notebook floats beside his knee-level hand instead of being clearly held; reads as a hovering icon.
what/line 2: the test-table top crosses the three citizens' torsos while its legs reach below their feet, making the depth ambiguous (people appear impaled by the bar rather than standing behind it).
what/line 3: at mid-sentence the yellow key travels across the warm keyhole opening and nearly disappears against the same hue; the peaceful hand-over is only legible at the end of the move.

what/line 4 at ~15%: the reader appears in the same spot where the outgoing office-holder is still fading, briefly showing two overlapping figures (ghost duplicate) before the incoming figure on the right also fades.

how/line 3: the 'winner' is not identified; the reward coins land on the Rules sign rather than visibly passing from market reward to the dais, so 'market reward becomes political power' relies on the caption.
how/line 4 at ~15%: the Findings card fades in directly over the still-fading occupant on the dais (brief cross-fade overlap).

positives: Exit bars, hidden-caste curtain reveal and bought podium track sentences 1-2 clearly; caption band clean in all themes and phone widths.
Occupant and challenger identities carry from 'how' into the peaceful key hand-over in 'what'; Night palette keeps characters and props legible.
Closing book shows the introduction title, bookmark and ten testable clauses matching the spoken starting point.
